description: 新北市污水下水道用戶接管普及率 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府水利局. 新普及率處理率計算依據污水下水道第五期建設計畫修正以接管戶數乘以各縣市戶量除以各縣市總人口數而得；各縣市總人口數及各縣市戶量資料來源為內政部戶政司人口資料（縣市人口性比例及人口密度）。. Coverage: 新北市政府水利局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府水利局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
